answer: Influence grows by continuity, not count: each identity signs a chain linking last epoch's state, client receipts, and locked stake, and its transaction limit rises only after several clean epochs. New keys begin under a low tide of credit, solid as shale only after time. A bridge from old reputation cannot be forged because receipts name outside clients. One honest agent ages once; a sybil farmer must lock stake and maintain every fake for epochs before it matters.
